mapper.update: UPDATE sys_job_cluster SET sys_job_cluster_leader_node = #{nodeId}, sys_job_cluster_lease_until_ms = #{leaseUntilMs}, sys_job_cluster_version = sys_job_cluster_version + 1 WHERE sys_job_cluster_id = #{group} AND ( sys_job_cluster_leader_node IS NULL OR sys_job_cluster_leader_node = #{nodeId} OR sys_job_cluster_lease_until_ms < #{nowMs} )
